item.title: Grass hasn't been cut in months, 20th August
item.description:
Would it be possible to have an update on the works taking place in William Booth Open Space and the adjacent Orchard Lodge Sports Fields please? The works commenced on 9th June and, according to Idverde signage, were expected to be completed in two weeks - Ten weeks have now passed. In this time the publicly accessible area of William Booth Open Space has become completely overgrown and unusable. I presume this is because contractors are unable to gain access with the machinery needed to maintain the site? Idverde have not replied to two emails asking for updates. Could you please let me know what works are taking place, why they are needed and when you now expect them to be finished? Can the grass to be cut whilst these works are going on?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): William Booth Road, Anerley, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
